notes.title: v1.1.1 - Many bugs squashed!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

I've just pushed a new patch of bug fixes. Nothing too glamorous, just more stability. :) 

Also ICYMI - the first chapter of "Lost Memories" DLC is coming soon, wishlist here!

v1.1.1 Patch Notes

[spoiler]- Fixed many situations where moves were incorrectly disallowed / allowed
- Fixed a handful of frame-specific undo/reset bugs
- Fixed a few bugs where crates joined by arrows could disconnect
- Fixed a few bugs where crumble blocks didn't crumble when they should
- Fixed a few bugs where crates didn't get impaled on spikes when they should
- Fixed a few bugs where crates could intersect
- Fixed a few bugs where arrows snapped when they shouldn't and vice versa
- Improved logic around when crates get pushed by a rotation vs when they get carried
- Fixed a bunch of bugs where crates that are carried by a rotation could do spooky things
- Fixed a softlock (seen in "Bodyguard")
- Disallow queueing of repeated "grab" action
- Fixed 2x2x1 shape with joined arrows could float
- Fixed crate incorrectly falling when a crate it's joined to is supported by a crumble block[/spoiler]

Fixed bugs where, under very specific circumstances, ...

[spoiler]- Player could walk through crates
- Flying crate doesn't fire when it should (seen in "Bodyguard")
- Climbing into a stack of crates pushes them too far 
- Wall spikes push crates by 2 tiles rather than 1
- Crate on head while climbing causes ghost pushing
- Movement incorrectly allowed while an arrow was mid-air (seen in "Turning The Corner")[/spoiler]

notes.title: Bonfire Peaks - Lost Memories announced, plus Photo Mode update out
notes.content: Bonfire Peaks, one of the nicest puzzle games released in 2021 is getting an expansion in Lost Memories plus an update is out now with new features.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/05/bonfire-peaks-lost-memories-announced-plus-photo-mode-update-out

notes.title: Photo Mode available now!
notes.content:
I'm very excited to announce that Photo Mode is available today! Please enjoy taking photos as you climb the mountain (and share them with us!). Here are the patch notes for our v1.1.0 update:

- Added Photo Mode! 
- Fixed several position rounding bugs at low framerates
- Fixed several rotation-based bugs at low framerates
- Minor edit to level "Moving Day"
- Fixed a softlock in level "Bodyguard"
- Minor mesh optimizations
- Audio mix edits

But also! Today, as part of the Draknek Direct 2022, we announced Bonfire Peaks: Lost Memories, a trilogy of DLC. Each chapter will include new puzzles and new mechanics, and Chapter One will be available in Q3 2022. 

[previewyoutube=d6rVGPZA7fg;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008250/Bonfire_Peaks__Lost_Memories/

One last thing - Bonfire Peaks is now part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase, running from the 19th-23rd of May. Get the game on discount and explore the showcase to find your next favorite puzzle game, too!

notes.title: Photo Mode coming soon and v1.0.27 bug fix patch now live!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=-kIfKvbdJwY;full][/previewyoutube]

Photo Mode is coming soon to Bonfire Peaks! 

We'll post another update along with some exciting news soon. 
In the meantime, here's some patch notes for some issues I fixed in v1.0.27, live now:


 Controller mapping is now displayed properly, but still not remappable
 Made snowy ground tiles easier to read
 Reduced polycount on some models to improve performance
 Fixed a bug where [spoiler]arrows can be pushed/pulled sideways into/out of arrow traps [/spoiler]
 Fixed a bug where walking on a supported 2x1 that's above a crate that's above [spoiler]spikes incorrectly impales the crate[/spoiler]
 Fixed a few bugs where crates weren't being carried when they should
 Mouse click in pause menu no longer deselects the active button
 Fixed overworld lighting not updating after undoing an overworld reset
 Walking on a 2x1 supported by both a crate and a [spoiler]crumbling block no longer crumbles the block[/spoiler]
 Undo state wasnt being tracked if you pivot without holding something, now it is
 Fixed a bug where collisions werent being checked if you quickly changed directions mid-move
 Fixed a bug where you could clip [spoiler]arrow-joined crates[/spoiler] through solid objects
 Fixed a few bugs where you could [spoiler]separate two crates joined by an arrow[/spoiler]
 Fixed a handful of edge cases where you could get stuck at a 45° angle
 Fixed a "pulling a crate out of an [spoiler]arrow trap while it was trying to fire[/spoiler]" bug found in Bodyguard
 Fixed a softlock that was possible in level Bodyguard

notes.title: Bonfire Peaks - out now!
notes.content:
Today, in partnership with director Corey Martin, Draknek & Friends is thrilled to announce that Bonfire Peaks is now available, with a 10% launch discount for the first week.

After three years in development the full game is a wonderful experience with over 200 puzzles. If you've played any Draknek game before we know you'll love this as well. Bonfire Peaks is our first foray into game publishing and we couldn't be happier with the result - expect a master class in puzzle design brought to life through beautiful voxel artwork and an atmospheric soundtrack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147890/Bonfire_Peaks/

Some early reviews:


 "Bonfire Peaks is a gorgeous experience, with a multitude of puzzles that will challenge even the most hardened genre aficionado." - Finger Guns, 9/10
 "A deeply thoughtful, eminently accessible and cleverly crafted bite-sized puzzler, Bonfire Peaks has more subtle emotion, charm and smile-cracking ingenuity than most of the games that have released this year." - PSU, 9.5/10
 "It’s a mostly sublime experience that is somehow equally demanding and relaxing, and uncovering all of its secrets offers an opportunity to flex your brain to the max." - Retroware, 9/10
 EDGE, 9/10
